ambiguities.text: The EIP uses 'at or after EIP-1559 activation' without specifying exact block number boundaries
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume activation is determined by the EIP-1559 fork block number configuration for the specific network. This should be verified against network-specific configurations.

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify behavior when the requested uncle block does not exist
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EIP-1474 error handling applies for non-existent blocks. The baseFee field logic only applies when a valid uncle block is found.

implicit_assumptions.description: The EIP-1559 activation block is correctly configured and consistently applied across all client implementations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent baseFee field presence could confuse clients or cause parsing errors if different nodes return different response formats for the same block.

implicit_assumptions.description: The baseFee value returned is the actual consensus-validated baseFee from the block header
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A malicious or buggy node could return incorrect baseFee values, misleading applications about historical gas prices.
